name: Kuraki Ryouko
source:
Mother of Azusa and sister of Sara.
When her husband died she was left with a huge debt.
She has to work in the residence in charge of free lodging.
[spoiler]She became Shinji sex-slave to protect her daughter.[/spoiler]
